phase: A recorded before any edit; status fields added after Phase B/C

defects.title: Reading save without an occurrence assigns a catalogue sense by spelling and skips the Reading mode policy
defects.root_cause: POST /api/vocabulary guards only sourceType=listening against occurrence-less, definition-less items. For sourceType=reading it falls through to enrichTerms(term), which picks a catalogue entry by spelling and sets canonicalLexemeId. That branch also never calls the Reading mode policy and never checks that sourceId is a real Reading source of this learner.
affected_ui: WordPopover 'Meaning not checked yet' -> Save (Reading / General Reading)
defects.reproduction_steps: 1) General Reading passage with an unresolved 'bank' (river). 2) Open popup: 'Meaning not checked yet'. 3) Press Save without typing a meaning -> client posts {sourceType:'reading', sourceId:passageId, items:[{term:'bank'}]} without occurrenceId. 4) Server enriches 'bank' by spelling. Also: same POST with sourceId = an ACTIVE Academic attempt id is accepted (no lock), and with a random uuid is accepted (forged source).
defects.expected_behavior: Reading words without a server-proven occurrence never receive a sense by spelling (422 needs_definition unless the learner writes the meaning). The Reading mode policy applies (403 lexical_assistance_locked during an active Academic attempt). An unknown Reading source is rejected (404).
defects.actual_behavior: Spelling-based catalogue sense may be stored; no lock; forged source accepted.
defects.planned_fix: In the occurrence-less branch: for sourceType=reading require sourceId, resolve it to this learner's attempt or a visible passage (404 otherwise), apply readingLexicalAccess (403 when locked), and require definitionEn exactly like Listening (422 needs_definition). Regression tests first (QA2 + HTTP).
defects.regression_risk: Low: the Reading UI only takes this path for unresolved words, where the learner's own meaning is already the intended behaviour.
defects.fix: src/lib/services/lexical/context.ts readingSourceAccess; src/app/api/vocabulary/route.ts occurrence-less Reading branch (404/403/422)
defects.verification: tests/general-reading-qa2.test.ts #26; HTTP E2E: pre-fix build 64/67 (3 VD-001 checks returned 200), post-fix 67/67. The spelling-sense half was not reproducible locally (no catalogue source configured for 'bank'); proven by code path only.

defects.title: Forged Listening sessionSenseId has no server-side/HTTP regression test
defects.root_cause: Only a UI test sends sessionSenseId; the server branch (route.ts ~l.99) that rejects a sense outside the session is untested.
defects.expected_behavior: A valid sense id from another source is rejected (404) and nothing is saved — proven by a test.
defects.planned_fix: Add HTTP E2E assertion against the production build + a QA2 DB assertion.
defects.verification: HTTP E2E: forged sessionSenseId -> 404, nothing saved
